term_and_condition:
Thank you for joining the FBSPORT Affiliate Program. Our goal is to build long-term partnerships with creators, athletes, coaches, clubs, and community leaders who genuinely love and promote FBSPORT products.

1. Program Participation

Participation in the FBSPORT Affiliate Program is subject to approval. FBSPORT reserves the right to accept, reject, or terminate any affiliate application at its sole discretion.

2. Affiliate Links & Discount Codes

Affiliates will receive a unique referral link and/or discount code to share with their audience. Commissions are earned only on eligible purchases tracked through the assigned link or code.

Affiliate links and codes may not be altered, transferred, sold, or shared as unauthorized public coupon codes.

3. Acceptable Promotion Methods

Affiliates may promote FBSPORT through:

  • Social media platforms
  • Personal websites and blogs
  • Email newsletters
  • YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, WhatsApp communities, and similar channels
  • Product reviews, tutorials, and training content

All promotions must be honest, accurate, and reflect genuine experiences with FBSPORT products.

4. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates may not:

  • Make false, misleading, or unverified claims about FBSPORT products
  • Use spam, unsolicited messages, or deceptive marketing practices
  • Create fake reviews or impersonate customers
  • Use FBSPORT trademarks, logos, or brand assets in a misleading manner
  • Advertise unauthorized discounts or pricing
  • Engage in fraudulent activities or attempt to manipulate tracking or commissions

5. Google Ads & Paid Advertising Policy

Affiliates may use paid advertising methods only in compliance with the following rules:

  • Affiliates may not bid on the keywords "FBSPORT", "FB SPORT", or any variations, misspellings, or trademarked brand terms in Google Ads, Bing Ads, or other search advertising platforms.
  • Affiliates may not use FBSPORT trademarks, brand names, or product names in ad headlines, display URLs, or ad copy without prior written permission.
  • Affiliates may not direct-link paid advertisements to the FBSPORT website using affiliate links.
  • Affiliates may not create advertisements that could cause confusion regarding an official relationship with FBSPORT or imply that they are the official FBSPORT website.
  • Affiliates may not use domains, subdomains, or social media usernames that contain "FBSPORT" or similar brand-identifying terms.
  • Affiliates may promote non-branded keywords related to gymnastics, air tracks, paddle boards, bounce houses, fitness equipment, cheerleading, tumbling, and similar categories, provided their advertisements comply with all program policies.
  • FBSPORT reserves the right to request modification or removal of any paid advertisement that may negatively impact the brand or violate these guidelines.
  • Violation of this paid advertising policy may result in suspension or termination from the FBSPORT Affiliate Program and forfeiture of unpaid commissions.

6. Commission Eligibility

Commissions are paid only on completed, valid purchases.

The following orders are not eligible for commission:

  • Refunded or canceled orders
  • Fraudulent transactions
  • Chargebacks
  • Self-purchases made solely to earn commissions

7. Content & Disclosure

Affiliates must comply with applicable advertising and consumer protection laws and clearly disclose affiliate relationships when required (e.g., "#affiliate", "#ad", or similar disclosures).

8. Payments

Commissions are paid according to the terms communicated during onboarding and are subject to any applicable minimum payout threshold.

Affiliates are responsible for reporting and paying any taxes related to commission earnings.

9. Program Changes & Termination

FBSPORT reserves the right to modify commission rates, program benefits, or these terms at any time.

Either party may terminate participation at any time. Violations of this policy may result in immediate removal from the program and forfeiture of unpaid commissions.

By participating in the FBSPORT Affiliate Program, you agree to comply with this policy and represent FBSPORT in a professional and ethical manner.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to marketing@fb-sport.com for support.
